note: Ghana's large banks were tried for credit card terms: Absa Bank Ghana, Stanbic Bank Ghana, Zenith Bank Ghana, Access Bank Ghana, UBA Ghana and Standard Chartered Ghana, chosen as the best-known card issuers (the Bank of Ghana's rankings weren't needed, as only Absa publishes current card terms that could be read). Absa Bank Ghana's tariff guide (September 2026), read in full: its Classic and Platinum credit cards cost GHS 100 and GHS 150 a year, bear 43% and 40% a year, charge 5% for a cash advance, a 7% scheme mark-up on spending abroad, a minimum monthly repayment of 5%, and give up to 55 days interest free. The late payment fee (10% or GHS 20, whichever is higher) doesn't say 10% of what, so it isn't written. The guide's Signature and Infinite credit cards carry fees (GHS 170 and GHS 200 a year, a GHS 200 issue fee on the Infinite, GHS 25 late, 5% cash advance) but no interest rate, so they can't be written. Stanbic Ghana's credit card page refused this client (403); Zenith Ghana's 2025 tariff guides answered 404; Access Bank Ghana's tariff guide is served with an expired certificate and wasn't fetched; UBA Ghana's 2026 tariff guide prices no credit card rate; Standard Chartered's Ghana tariff guide dates from January 2018 and isn't current.
